title: yaml-dsl.yml
description: The workspace's YAML DSLs: which files each one owns and the syntax of its names, references, placeholders and calls.

file_includes.description: Globs of the files the DSL owns. A glob starting with {config_root}/ matches below the config's folder.

file_excludes.description: Globs of files the DSL does not own, even when file_includes matches them. A glob starting with {config_root}/ matches below the config's folder.

schema_search_paths.description: Schemas tried in order when a file names none, or the one it names is not on disk. Each path is relative to the file, or to the config's folder when it starts with {config_root}/; a URL is fetched.

tag.description: The YAML tag as written, such as !Ref.

key.description: The key the tagged node stands for, such as Ref.

tag_keys.description: YAML tags that stand for keys: a tagged node reads as a map holding the key, the node its value.

key_sort_orders.description: Where an edit places a new key in each map. The first entry whose path covers the map applies.

references.description: How names are referenced. Rules reading the same text are tried in order.

layers.description: The common layer and its overlays. Left out for a DSL without layers.

common_layer_discovery.description: How an overlay and its common layer are paired: by the overlay folder's parent, by the nearest ancestor above an overlay folder, or by an include in the overlay.

overlay_includes.description: How an include in an overlay names its common layer. Read only with common_layer_discovery overlay_includes.

common_layer_files.description: A layer file name to the names its common layer may take, the first that exists taken. {concern} in a name stands for a concern below its overlays, and each list holds a name without it. Left out, the common layer takes the layer file's own name.

duplicate_check.description: The unit a suggestion takes, a node of the overlays it moves or deletes whole.

depth.description: How many levels below the document root the unit sits, under a top-level key key_depths does not list.

key_depths.description: The unit's depth under a given top-level key, {} when every key takes depth.

skip_keys.description: Keys no suggestion compares or moves, at any depth.

overlay_include.description: An include: a key whose value names the common layer merged in place of the include.

key_paths.description: JSONPaths of the keys whose values are includes, such as $..['Fn::Transform']. A value that is a list holds one include per map.

key.description: A key the include value holds.

value.description: The value it holds at that key.

value_conditions.description: The key and value pairs an include value holds, [] for none.

location_path.description: A JSONPath of names from the include value to its location, such as $.Parameters.Location.

local.description: The local path a remote location stands for, relative to the overlay, or to the config's folder when it starts with {config_root}/.

location_mappings.description: A location starting with remote names the file at local followed by the rest of the location. A location none covers names no file.

placeholder.description: The placeholder syntax. Left out for a DSL without placeholders.

pattern.description: Regular expression of a placeholder, with a (?<body>...) group.

unscanned_paths.description: Paths whose text is another language's and is not read for placeholders.

function.description: Function calls. Left out for a DSL without calls.

definitions.description: Sources of the function table, merged in order.

call_result_reference_positions.description: Positions from which a name a call declares may be referenced.

calls_not_allowed_at.description: Paths where a call is a problem.

loops.description: The names a loop macro binds within its body. Left out for a DSL that reads no loop names.

scope_name.description: The scope, declared under scopes, whose reference rules read loop names.

locals.description: Named values. Left out for a DSL without locals.

scope_name.description: The scope, declared under scopes, whose declarations are the locals.

path_separator.description: The text between the steps of a path into a local, read after the local's name. Left out, a local is read whole.

performance.description: How the editor keeps a large schema fast. Left out for a DSL that needs none of it.

compiled_schema_cache.description: Whether the compiled schema is kept in the extension's storage and loaded in later sessions instead of compiled.

validator.description: How a document is read before it is validated against its schema. Left out for a DSL whose documents are validated as written.

merge_base_keys.description: Deprecated: call a `merge` macro whose argument is the content instead.

pattern.description: Regular expression of a key that sets a field of its own entry, with (?<field>...) and (?<value>...) groups.

child_values_from_parent_key.description: Keys that set a field of the entry they key.

allow_quoted_values.description: Types a quoted value is validated as, where the schema expects that type and the string spells one. Defaults to [].

marker_function.description: A call written in a key: <name> <call_marker><function>. Left out when the DSL's calls take another shape.

call_marker.description: Text that opens a call in a key.

splat_operator.description: Suffix after the function that spreads a list value into the arguments; `null` where the function table decides how a value binds the arguments.

calls_without_name_allowed.description: Whether a key that is the marker alone is a call, the only key of its map.

scopes.description: The DSL's scopes. A name in capitals is a logical scope; any other name is the DSL's own word.

regions.description: Paths whose subtree in any file of the fold sees the scope's names; $ is the whole fold.

later_items_of_declaring_list.description: Whether a name is also visible in the later items of the list that declares it.

named_by_parent_key.description: Whether the mapping key enclosing a declaration is the scope its name is in. Logical scopes only.

builtin_names.description: Names the scope holds without a declaration. Logical scopes only.

skip_keys.description: Keys a .*, [*] or ..* step does not descend into.

exclude_candidates.description: Keys at the last step that declare nothing.

name_source.description: Where the name is read: the key, the scalar value, or a meta argument of the key.

key_token.description: The words of the key that are the name; null when the name is not read from the key.

name_spelling.description: How the name is spelled for references.

meta_argument_name.description: The meta argument holding the name; null when the name is not read from a meta argument.

declares_every_name.description: Whether the key declares every name of the scope, for names defined in a document the editor does not read.

pattern.description: Regular expression of a reference, with named groups.

positions.description: Positions the reference may stand in.

text_after_name_allowed.description: Whether text such as a field path may follow the name.

scope_name.description: The scope the reference resolves in, declared under scopes.

scope_group.description: The pattern group holding the scope of a named_by_parent_key scope; null for any other scope.

name_group.description: The pattern group holding the name.

skip_keys.description: Keys a .*, [*] or ..* step does not select or descend into.

order.description: Where a new key goes among the map's keys.

first_keys.description: Under significance, keys at the top of the map, in this order. [] under alphabetical.

last_keys.description: Under significance, keys at the bottom of the map, in this order. [] under alphabetical.

skip_keys.description: Keys a .*, [*] or ..* step does not select or descend into.

includes_subtree.description: Deprecated: list the path ending in ..* as its own entry instead.

path.description: A JSONPath (RFC 9535) from $, with .name, ['name'], ..name, .* and [*] steps and an optional final ..*.
